cue: A percolation gadget transfer is justified only by equal pair connection probabilities
fire_when: Fair three-terminal selector and independent star of arm probability 1/sqrt(2): all three pair checks agree, but wiring a~c changes the crossing probability by (2-sqrt(2))/4
silent_when: The complete boundary-partition laws are proved equal, or the signed cumulative crossing defect is explicitly retained as an open gap
text: For a percolation gadget transfer, check the full boundary-partition law. Matched pair probabilities can change a wired crossing. An approximate transfer needs a bound on the signed cumulative replacement defect.
